get.description:
Check Postgres, Redis and object storage independently and concurrently.

Args:
    response: the outgoing response, whose status is set to 503 when any check fails.

Returns:
    One status string per dependency.

Side effects:
    Opens one DB connection, one Redis connection and one S3 request.

503.description: At least one dependency is failing.

head.description:
Answer HEAD /v1/healthz without touching any dependency.

This is the phones' reachability probe (plan §13 A1, 3 s timeout before every sync run). It must not
depend on S3 or the DB: a slow S3 would make every phone think it is offline and stop pushing
entries, and a deep check per probe would multiply backend load on a public route.

Returns:
    An empty 200 response.

200.description: The API is reachable; dependencies are not checked.
